title: Vandermonde construction work formula
statement: For natural numbers $k$ and $n$, set $\ell=\max(1,\lceil\log_2 n\rceil)$, where $\lceil\log_2 n\rceil$ is the least natural number $r$ such that $2^r\ge n$. The work assigned to the executable Vandermonde construction with parameters $k,n$ is the binary field preprocessing work at parameter $\ell$, plus $n$ times one more than the work for the first $k-1$ power rows at parameter $\ell$.
